name: CoinMarketCap
description: CoinMarketCap lets agents read crypto prices, market data, technical indicators, on-chain metrics, market sentiment, and crypto news from CoinMarketCap. Each user signs in to their own CoinMarketCap account through the browser, or connects with an API key. A free account includes monthly credits. The tools only read data: they cannot trade or move funds.

prompts.text: What are the current prices of Bitcoin and Ethereum, and how did they change in the last 7 days?
Give me a market overview: total market cap, Bitcoin dominance, and the Fear and Greed index.
Show the 14-day RSI and MACD for Solana, and tell me what they suggest.

apps.name: CoinMarketCap
apps.description: Crypto prices, market data, indicators and news, over CoinMarketCap's MCP server with browser sign-in or an API key.

fields.label: API key
fields.hint: In CoinMarketCap, open API > Dashboard > API Keys and copy your key.
